ui_restart_count.description: Supervisor cumulative reserved UI restart attempts; null when no trustworthy current observation.

observed_age_ms.description: Age at the source sampled_mono_ms, not send time; preserve both through queues. Fresh completed-loop sample uses zero; unknown uses uint32 max.

max_result_age_ms.description: Initial Core acceptance freshness only; committed evidence remains guard-bound during the original 120-second WAIT_CONFIRM window.

captured_mono_ms.description: Conservative exposure-start lower bound: SOE timestamp or driver timestamp minus a verified exposure/pipeline upper bound stored in camera profile. MONOTONIC alone is insufficient.

retryable.description: 只允许按规范查询/复用原幂等键重试；不代表可重放硬件动作。
